title: On the well-posedness and efficient approximation for the classical Melan equation in suspension bridges
summary: The classical Melan equation modeling suspension bridges is considered. We first study the explicit expression and global properties of the analytical solution for the simplified ``less stiff'' model, based on which we derive an a priori estimate for the original classical Melan equation and establish, under an explicit load condition, that it has a unique solution with nonnegative integral under downward live loads, thereby showing the uniqueness of the corresponding deflection curve in the engineering setting.
